sections.text:
This document outlines the 
testing procedure I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.

This patent concerns the test 
 of protection relays of the generator manufactured by SKODA 
 PLZEN. 
 The generator is of type 3 H6688/2VH, rated active power 222MW, rated 
 apparent power 277.5MVA, power factor 0.8, and voltages 15.75 
 5%KV.

The first draft initiated by eng. Maysa Sayed 
 Ahmed Ahmady, tested at 2 June 2003 by 
 eng. Iman Rizk Abdel_Hamed El_Ashry, reviewed by eng. Adel Abd El Kader 
 EL Nagar EDEPCo. quality control engineer, accepted by general director eng. 
 Mahmoud El Sayed Sakr, and approved by eng. Mohamed Reda Abdel Aziz Soliman, 
 Pi - Talkha Sector Head.

Disconnect the trip leads of the relay and

This patent concerns the test
